title: Coordenador de contrato - supervisão de obra de subestação e linhas de trasmissão/distribuição
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Coordenador de contrato - supervisão de obra de subestação e linhas de trasmissão/distribuição em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

A QUADRANTE   Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1100 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes.   O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia a dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades.   Objetivo do Cargo   Coordenar os serviços de supervisão de obras de Subestações e Linhas de Transmissão/Distribuição, garantindo o acompanhamento técnico, contratual e gerencial da execução dos empreendimentos, assegurando conformidade com projetos, especificações técnicas, cronogramas, requisitos de qualidade, segurança e diretrizes do cliente.   Principais Responsabilidades   Coordenar as equipes de supervisão e fiscalização de campo nas obras de Subestações e Linhas de Transmissão/Distribuição; Atuar como principal interface entre cliente, construtoras, equipes de supervisão e engenharia; Garantir o adequado acompanhamento técnico das atividades civis, eletromecânicas, montagem elétrica, testes e comissionamento; Assegurar conformidade dos serviços executados com projetos, especificações técnicas, normas aplicáveis e requisitos contratuais; Coordenar reuniões de acompanhamento, alinhamentos técnicos e reporte gerencial ao cliente; Acompanhar cronogramas físicos, marcos contratuais e evolução das atividades de obra; Consolidar relatórios gerenciais, registros de campo, indicadores de desempenho, qualidade e segurança; Gerenciar desvios, interferências, não conformidades e planos de ação corretiva; Coordenar validações de medições, avanços físicos e documentação técnica da obra; Garantir cumprimento dos requisitos de SSMA durante a execução das atividades; Apoiar análisesde pleitos, alterações de escopo e impactos técnicos/contratuais; Promover integração entre disciplinas, equipes de campo e áreas de apoio do projeto; Assegurar adequada rastreabilidade documental e controle das informações da supervisão. Informações adicionais   É essencial que o candidato tenha disponibilidade para viagens. Vaga para atuar em todo Brasil, principalmente em Salvador - BA, com viagens constantes. Requisitos   Formação superior em Engenharia Elétrica, Civil, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em coordenação de contratos de supervisão ou fiscalização de obras de Subestações e Linhas de Transmissão/Distribuição; Conhecimento emexecução de obras do setor elétrico, planejamento, qualidade e gestão contratual; Experiência em coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares de campo; Conhecimento emgestão de cronogramas, medições, controle físico-financeiro e gestão de riscos; Disponibilidadepara atuação em campo e deslocamentos conforme necessidade do contrato. Competências Desejáveis   Liderança e capacidade de coordenação operacional; Boa comunicaçãoe relacionamento com cliente e contratadas; Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados; Capacidade de tomada de decisão e resolução de conflitos; Visão crítica sobre qualidade, segurança e desempenho da obra; Comprometimentocom excelência operacional e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos essenciais   Experiência com CAD 3 D para projetos mecânicos (preferencialmente PTC Creo ou similar) em nível intermediário a avançado; Experiência em projeto e detalhamento de peças e conjuntos mecânicos; Domínio em leitura e elaboração de desenho técnico mecânico; Experiência comestrutura de produto (lista de materiais / BOM); Experiência em interface técnica com engenharia e produção, especialmente em usinagem e injeção plástica; Conhecimento em GD& T (controle geométrico de tolerâncias); Experiência mínima de 5 anos em projetos mecânicos; Formação técnica, tecnólogo ou engenharia nas áreas mecânicas ou correlatas. Diferenciais   Experiência em desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Conhecimento emanálise de tolerâncias (stack-up); Experiência comdocumentação técnica e controle de projetos; Experiência revisando ou orientando tecnicamente outros desenhistas ou projetistas. Perfil profissional   Senioridade técnica com atuação operacional; Perfil analítico e detalhista; Boa comunicaçãotécnica com engenharia e produção; Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em projetos; Organização na gestão de documentação técnica. Benefícios:   Vale Alimentação; Vale Refeição; Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível; Convênio médicocoparticipativo para colaboradores (opcional); Convênio odontológico para colaboradores e dependentes (opcional); Parceria com a faculdade Esamc, desconto nas mensalidades de Graduações, Tecnólogos e MBA; Seguro de vida.

title: Technical assistant
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical assistant em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?   At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.   DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.   About The Job   The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.   Working Tasks and Responsibilities   Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF's technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers' sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects. What You'll Bring   Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.   At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.   We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.   Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at Deif. Com.

title: Gerente de operações da mentoria
description:

Sobre o Grupo Escalada   Somos um ecossistema com diversas soluções para empresas que desejam vender os seus produtos na internet ou que já vendem e querem aumentar os seus resultados. Nosso propósito é transformar o comércio digital no Brasil. Aqui, valorizamos inovação, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e pessoas com brilho nos olhos.   Representada por Dhiego Rosa – Instagram:@dhiegorosa e You Tube: dhiegorosa – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.   Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre, destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina.   O que buscamos:   Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações da Mentoria para liderar e estruturar a operação da nossa principal linha de negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, padronização de processos, qualidade na entrega e desenvolvimento da equipe.   Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico e analítico, alta capacidade de gestão, autonomia para tomada de decisão e experiência em operações escaláveis, capaz de atuar diretamente na evolução da experiência dos mentorados e crescimento sustentável da área.   Responsabilidades:   Liderar equipe de mentores, supervisores e suporte, acompanhando performance, desenvolvimento e estruturação do time; Garantir qualidade e consistência da operação de mentoria, assegurando padronização de processos, entregas e experiência do cliente; Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos operacionais, metodologias e processos internos; Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais, como NPS, churn, engajamento, capacidade operacional e satisfação dos mentorados; Realizar gestãode crises, tratativas de casos críticos, conflitos e demandas sensíveis de clientes; Planejar capacidade operacional da equipe, onboarding e desenvolvimento de novos mentores; Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, RH, Financeiro, Marketing e Produto. Requisitos:   Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas; Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de operações, customer success, consultoria, educação executiva ou áreas correlatas; Experiência comprovada em estruturação de processos, padronização de entrega e gestão por indicadores em empresas de serviço continuado, como educação executiva, consultoria, mentoria, treinamento corporativo, Saa S B2 B ou customer success de alto contato; Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes operacionais de médio/grande porte; Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento de performance, incluindo OKRs, KPIs, dashboards gerenciais, CRM e plataformas de operação digital; Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e implementação de melhorias contínuas; Capacidade demonstrável de atuar com autonomia, senso de dono e reporte de resultados, sem dependência de direcionamento constante; Perfil analítico, organizado, resiliente e com forte capacidade de liderança; Vivência em operações escaláveis e ambientes de crescimento acelerado. Diferenciais:   Experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, educação online ou consultorias; Conhecimento eme-commerce, marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee) e comércio digital; Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento, scale-ups ou operações com ticket elevado; Vivência empreendedora ou passagem por empresas em fase de crescimento acelerado, com familiaridade em ambientes dinâmicos, alta autonomia e processos em estruturação; Compreensão da realidade do pequeno e médio empreendedor brasileiro, incluindo desafios relacionados à tributação, capital de giro, sazonalidade e gestão operacional. Se você se identifica com a nossa missão de impactar o mercado de e-commerce e busca crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, queremos conhecer você!   Venha construir o futuro do comércio digital conosco no Grupo Escalada

Descrição da vaga   A Liu Gong Latin America está em busca de um(a) novo(a) Analista de Contas a Receber para integrar à nossa equipe.   Sobre a Liu Gong Latin America   A Liu Gong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo Liu Gong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a Liu Gong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos. title: Captain - airbus a320
description:

Job DescriptionMake the world your home.It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.What we offerEtihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up toAED 674,029 (USD 181,589)per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits:Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits fromany location in the world The RoleAs a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bringTo be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDSAdditional InformationEtihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our "Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.To learn more visit Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:   The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.     KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:   Quarterly package review - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.   - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.   - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.   - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.   - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.     Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.     One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.     OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS: The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.     REQUIREMENTS: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).   Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:   Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4 HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.   In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio; Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação; Graduação completa; Inglês avançado.  Nosso compromisso com a diversidade    Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.    Faça parte da nossa história    Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

description:

About Us  YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.  What It’s Like to Work at YipitData  YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities:  Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including; Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring; Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.  Requirements:  Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstrated independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper  standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent; unblemished reputation; knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities; technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:

Location:  Remote Type:  Full-Time Reports to:  CEO Stack:  TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:  Immediate The Company  Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role  You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do  Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.  Must-Haves  Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.  Strong Signals  Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.  Red Flags  AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.  Who This Person Is  3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate  No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.  What We Offer  A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.  To Apply or Refer  Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Post Producer  Location:  Remote Position Type:  Contract Company:  Pocket FM About Us  At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer  to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content. Role Overview  As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners. Key Responsibilities  1. Post Production Operations Management   Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules. 2. Post Production Team Coordination   Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs. 3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management   Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline. 4. Stakeholder Collaboration   Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards. 5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight   Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release. 6. Vendor & Partner Management   Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners. 7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement   Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes. 8. Process & Workflow Optimization   Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution. 9. Volume & Deadline Management   Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards. 10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment  Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs. 11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership   Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives. 12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion  Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards. Qualifications  7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows. Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks. Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams. Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards. Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

About  Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development. Job Summary  This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position. Responsibilities  Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture. Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers. Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python  or Node.js (Express, NestJS) . Contribute to frontend development using React  and modern JavaScript/TypeScript  practices. Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle. Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows. Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices. Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability. Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.  Qualifications  Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency. 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js. Proficiency with frontend technologies  such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript . Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments. Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL. Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.  Benefits  Yearly Office Allowance Budget Macbook Purchase Support Wellbeing Support  If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.  We only accept CVs that are in English.  Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O que buscamos:  Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica). O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica. Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão. Pré-Requisitos:  Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas); Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso. Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator; Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo); Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h.  Será um diferencial se você tiver: Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão. Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos WorkFront);  Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências  em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)?  #VEMSERSTUDIORX  -- Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas!

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role  The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities  Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications  5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.  What Success Looks Like  Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Médico Pediatra (RQE)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Pediatra (RQE) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra,  comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você! O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria  de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.   Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.  Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES  Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA   Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo ; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.  Competências Comportamentais:  Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Project Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.  Required Skills & Experience • 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.  • Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.  • Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.  • Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.  • Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability. Nice to Have Skills & Experience • CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.  • Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).  • AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).  • Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).  • Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks. Job Description The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.  • Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.  • Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.  • Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”  • Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.  • Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.  • Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.  • Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.  • Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.  • Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.  • Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Parceiro de vendas
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Parceiro de vendas em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Tax Tech, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil.  Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level? Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita? O Grupo AG Tax Tech, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso. Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco. Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões:  1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos: Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas; Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado. 2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador: Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção? Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero. 3) Mentalidade \"TaxTech\" Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário. O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria:  •Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes. •Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos. •Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual). •Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. title: FX Trader
description:
Empresa está contratando FX Trader em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)  or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)  markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
Empresa está contratando Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
