title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. title: AI Operations Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para AI Operations Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Our Client  Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.  Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role  We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer  to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence  Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack  Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence  Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)  Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics  Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings  Field & Event Activation  Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works  Internal AI Tooling  Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering  What We're Looking For Required  3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time  Strongly Preferred  Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration  You'll thrive here if you  Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes  What Success Looks Like By 90 days:  Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months:  Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months:  PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

Empresa está contratando Desenvolvedor(a) Flutter - Sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Desenvolvedor(a) Flutter - Sênior  A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.    Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais  para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás  confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.   Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência . Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?   Qual será o seu papel? Você vai atuar como desenvolvedor(a) Flutter em um app com alto volume de usuários e impacto direto em vendas, trabalhando em uma arquitetura madura e bem estruturada. Seu foco será evoluir fluxos críticos junto a um time multidisciplinar, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência ao Design System, com liberdade real para propor melhorias estruturais no produto. Como será seu dia a dia? Você vai colaborar de perto com Produto, Design, Backend e QA na construção e evolução de funcionalidades, participar de code reviews, contribuir com a documentação interna e garantir que o app funcione bem nos dois mercados que atendemos: Brasil e EUA, em iOS e Android. O uso de IA (Claude Code, Copilot e similares) faz parte da rotina do time; esperamos que você use essas ferramentas com fluência e senso crítico, revisando o que é gerado e respondendo pela qualidade das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência sólida em Flutter / Dart com apps publicados em loja (iOS e Android); Domínio de Clean Architecture ou arquiteturas por camadas (domain / data / presentation); Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (GetX, Bloc, Riverpod ou similar); Consumo de APIs REST, tratamento de erros e autenticação via JWT; Conhecimento de testes em Flutter (unitários e de widget); Git com fluxo de pull requests, code review e branches por feature/bugfix; Integrações nativas básicas em Android (Gradle, flavors) e iOS (Xcode, CocoaPods); Inglês avançado ou fluente.  Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com ferramentas de CRM e mensageria como Emarsys, OneSignal ou Braze (push + in-app); Conhecer plataformas de atribuição mobile como AppsFlyer ou Adjust; Já tiver trabalhado com CI/CD mobile usando Fastlane, Codemagic, Bitrise ou GitHub Actions; Souber propor melhorias em prompts, automações e fluxos com IA que aumentem a produtividade do time;   Curtiu a oportunidade?  Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Back End Developer

Senior Software Engineer (Backend-Focused – Ruby/Elixir Platform Transformation)  Position Overview  We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a backend-focused engineering team responsible for modernizing and transforming core vendor platform systems. This role will primarily focus on building scalable backend services, improving vendor onboarding and intake workflows, and contributing to a large multi-year platform transformation initiative. The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with experience building distributed systems, scalable APIs, and cloud-native applications using Ruby, Elixir, or other strongly typed object-oriented backend languages such as Java, Kotlin, or C#. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on execution, reliability, and delivery within a collaborative Agile environment. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs Contribute to the Vendor Platform Transformation initiative and modernization efforts Build clean, performant, testable, and maintainable code Work on distributed systems, event-driven workflows, and backend integrations Participate in system design discussions and architectural decision-making Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams Support migration and modernization of legacy systems into scalable cloud-native services Review pull requests and contribute to engineering best practices Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability and observability Contribute to backend workflows involving vendor onboarding, intake processing, and operational systems  Required Qualifications  5-7+ years of software engineering experience Strong backend engineering experience with Ruby and/or Elixir Experience with Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, or other strongly typed backend languages is highly valued Strong understanding of scalable backend systems and distributed architectures Experience building REST APIs and microservices Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP Strong understanding of databases such as PostgreSQL, Redis, or NoSQL systems Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments Ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and containerized deployments Strong problem-solving and debugging skills  Preferred Qualifications  Experience with Elixir/Phoenix ecosystems Experience working on platform transformation or migration initiatives Familiarity with domain-driven design (DDD) and scalable service design Exposure to observability, logging, and monitoring tools Experience with GraphQL Experience with distributed data processing or ingestion pipelines Familiarity with eCommerce, marketplace, logistics, or vendor onboarding systems

Um(a) profissional com domínio técnico em ferramentas como Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace, e com profundo conhecimento em práticas modernas de observabilidade, rastreamento distribuído e automação de alertas. Esperamos alguém que atue de forma estratégica, proponha padrões técnicos, eleve a maturidade dos nossos sistemas e dissemine boas práticas de visibilidade, performance e resiliência em toda a organização. O candidato ideal é colaborativo, analítico, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de dono, sempre alinhado aos valores e à visão da empresa. Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:   Como Especialista SRE, essa pessoa será protagonista na evolução da plataforma de observabilidade da Empresa. Trará valor ao consolidar métricas, logs e rastreamentos em soluções robustas, garantindo visibilidade em tempo real, diagnóstico preciso de falhas e resposta eficiente a incidentes. Sua atuação será decisiva para o aumento da confiabilidade dos serviços, redução de indisponibilidades, melhoria contínua da performance e apoio estratégico às áreas de tecnologia e produto. Com sua expertise, teremos uma operação mais preditiva, escalável e resiliente.  • Liderar a implementação e evolução da plataforma de observabilidade, consolidando logs, métricas e traces.  • Definir, padronizar e manter painéis e alertas para serviços críticos da organização.  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs), orientando decisões técnicas com base em dados.  • Automatizar respostas a alertas e reduzir o toil por meio de scripts e integrações entre ferramentas.  • Atuar na gestão de incidentes: triagem, coordenação de resolução, documentação e melhoria contínua.  • Apoiar squads de produto e infraestrutura na análise de performance e comportamento dos sistemas.  • Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de observabilidade nos ciclos de desenvolvimento e operações.  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos sobre métricas, rastreamento e diagnóstico de aplicações.  • Evoluir continuamente o processo de detecção proativa e resposta rápida a falhas.  • Apoiar auditorias e relatórios técnicos com dados precisos de disponibilidade e incidentes. Principais conhecimentos:   • Observabilidade ponta a ponta com Zabbix, Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) e Dynatrace. • Criação, padronização e manutenção de dashboards operacionais, executivos e técnicos.  • Implementação e monitoramento de SLIs, SLOs e SLAs alinhados a objetivos de negócio.  • Rastreamento distribuído (Distributed Tracing) com Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger ou similares.  • Monitoramento de ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e conteinerizados (Kubernetes, Docker).  • Integração com ferramentas de alerta e resposta a incidentes: Opsgenie, PagerDuty, VictorOps.  • Automação de processos operacionais e scripts para coleta e análise de dados (Python, Shell, PowerShell).  • Participação ativa em war rooms, execução de post-mortems e condução de RCA (Root Cause Analysis).  • Criação e manutenção de documentação operacional (runbooks, playbooks, checklists).  • Colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para antecipação de riscos e padronização de visibilidade. Perfil acadêmico e habilidades:   • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como SRE, Observability Engineer ou DevOps com foco em monitoramento.  • Domínio técnico de Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace em ambientes de missão crítica.  • Forte entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e métricas operacionais.  • Vivência com rastreamento distribuído e integração de logs/métricas em pipelines CI/CD.  • Capacidade de correlacionar dados de observabilidade com impacto no negócio.  • Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e orquestração de contêineres (Kubernetes).  • Fluência em automação com linguagens como Python, Shell Script, Go ou similares.  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo com múltiplas áreas.  • Visão sistêmica, senso crítico e iniciativa para liderar projetos de melhoria contínua. Qualificações Desejáveis:  • Certificações em observabilidade e confiabilidade: Dynatrace Associate, Zabbix Certified, Elastic Observability, SRE Foundation.  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e OpenTelemetry.  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering e validação de resiliência.  • Participação em incidentes críticos com liderança técnica na resposta.  • Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e desafios de visibilidade em ambientes distribuídos.  • Experiência com automação de runbooks e fluxos de resposta a incidentes.  • Familiaridade com práticas de FinOps e eficiência operacional em observabilidade.  • Participação em comunidades técnicas de SRE, DevOps e observabilidade. • Contribuições para ferramentas ou boas práticas open source.  • Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e participação em fóruns internacionais.  Modelo de contratação:  Contrato: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)   Modelo de atuação:   Modelo: 100% Remoto  Na RÓDIO TECH, conectamos os melhores profissionais às melhores vagas. title: GTM Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando GTM Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Our Client  Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain.  Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role  We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer  to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought \"this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\" this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence  Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic \"growing your trucking business\" pitch Stand up intent-data and remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack  Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence  Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems)  Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics  Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings  Field & Event Activation  Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works  Internal AI Tooling  Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering  What We're Looking For Required  3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL; comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time  Strongly Preferred  Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration  You'll thrive here if you  Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing; You'd rather ship a v1 in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers; their adoption of what you build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes  What Success Looks Like By 90 days:  Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team; outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months:  Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months:  PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer. This role will be the first dedicated front-end engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, technical ownership, and architectural judgment. This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead  to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market. As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series. The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks. Key Responsibilities  1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction  Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners. Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery. Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals. Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.  2. Promo Creation & Localization  Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series. Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences. Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.  3. Production & Quality Control  Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery. Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output. Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives. Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.  4. Dubbing Agency Management  Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production. Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery. Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit. Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.  5. Performance Reworks & Optimization  Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues. Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance. Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals. Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles. Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.  6. Process, Tracking & Reporting  Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered. Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset. Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders. Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.  7. AI Tool Adoption  Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement. Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency. Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production. Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.  8. Market & Audience Understanding  Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends. Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences. Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.  Qualifications  Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production. Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement. Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors. Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese. Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances. Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors. Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement. Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes. Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation. Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale. They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action. Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

 Profile:  Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:  TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We’re hiring a Client Services Assistant  to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a “wait for instructions” role. It’s for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You’ll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what’s missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You’ll Own ----------- Client Services Operations  This is the center of the role. You’ll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, HubSpot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You’ll also help catch what’s slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You’ll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won’t be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You’ll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You’ll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won’t own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don’t speak up • Think “done” means “mostly handled” • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern SaaS systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include ClickUp, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. If shortlisted, we will ask that you submit: • Your resume  • A short video introducing yourself  and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a final list of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We’re looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you’re the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands. Job Description  We’re looking for a Senior Lead Designer to own design strategy and execution for a dedicated optimization client. This role is for a designer who thrives in a long-term client relationship — someone who can lead UX strategy conversations, build wireframes, design polished deliverables, and present work directly to highly involved stakeholders. You’ll work closely with project managers, developers, and junior designers to bring cohesive web experiences to life, while serving as the primary design voice on the account. Strong UX thinking and time management are essential — you’ll be expected to self-direct and keep work moving with minimal oversight. Key Responsibilities  ● Own the creative and design process. ● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet high-quality standards and align with client goals. ● Lead UX and content strategy for a dedicated optimization client, translating goals into clear design direction. ● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience. ● Build wireframes and design polished, conversion-focused web experiences from strategy through execution. ● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions. ● Create and design visual systems and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites. ● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites. ● Present creative work and strategic rationale directly to clients, navigating feedback with patience and professionalism. ● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs. ● Direct junior designers as needed, providing clear briefs and feedback to maintain quality. ● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team. ● Collaborate with developers for seamless Webflow handoff and execution. ● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality. ● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively. ● Proactively surface opportunities to improve the client’s digital experience. Qualifications  ● Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field. ● 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B or SaaS brands. ● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking — not just visual execution. ● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma. ● High proficiency in Figma required. ● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility. ● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers. ● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members. ● Proven experience presenting work and leading client conversations, especially with opinionated stakeholders. ● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines. ● Collaborative, ego-free mindset with the patience to manage evolving feedback without losing momentum. ● Strong time management and the ability to self-direct within a long-term account structure. ● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow. ● Portfolio showing both strategic thinking and visual craft, end-to-end. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment. ● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies. Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you’re passionate about design, technology, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL
description:
Confira a oportunidade para CONSULTORA COMERCIAL | CLÍNICA DE HARMONIZAÇÃO FACIAL em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED: Consultora comercial que sabe que lead quente não espera. E que não vai deixar nenhum escapar. Cara leitora, Se você está rolando o LinkedIn há dias vendo as mesmas vagas de sempre... \"Buscamos profissional proativo com boa comunicação\" \"Requisitos: Excel avançado e experiência na área\" \"Oferecemos: salário compatível com o mercado\" ..e sente que nenhuma dessas vagas te dá vontade de levantar da cadeira e se candidatar... Para. Essa aqui é diferente. Sabe aquela sensação de fazer uma venda e pensar \"eu SABIA que ia fechar\"? É isso que você vai sentir aqui. Todo dia. Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização. O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez. Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento. Esse alguém é você. Você não vai precisar convencer ninguém de que harmonização funciona - os antes e depois fazem isso. Você não vai precisar criar desejo do zero - as fotos e vídeos criam. Você não vai precisar explicar por que vale a pena - as pacientes satisfeitas mostram. O que você vai precisar fazer é simples e poderoso: responder rápido, entender o momento da cliente, tirar as dúvidas certas, e não deixar ela escapar enquanto \"pensa\". A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga. É uma máquina. E você é a peça que faz ela funcionar. Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher. SOBRE A CLÍNICA Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias. Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações. A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe. O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas. VOCÊ É... O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão. Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo. Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo. Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim. Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado. É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha. Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso. SUA MISSÃO Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes. Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil. ..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui... Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok? Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia. A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco. NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI: ● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar. ● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas. ● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir. ● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento. ● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa. ● Follow-up como rotina sagrada: 	○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele. 	○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real. 	○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir. 	○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda. 	○ Paciente que fez há 6 meses? Hora da manutenção. ● Trabalhar a base de pacientes existentes: Quem já fez uma vez, volta. Quem gostou, indica. Sua função é ativar isso. Todo dia. ● Manter o CRM organizado em tempo real: Status atualizado, próximo passo definido, histórico completo. Você precisa saber exatamente onde cada lead está no funil. SEUS INDICADORES DE SUCESSO O QUE MUDA NO SEU DIA A DIA Urgência é regra. Seguidor que comentou AGORA precisa ser atendido AGORA. Não daqui a pouco. Não quando der. AGORA. Lead quente esfria em minutos. A concorrente responde em segundos. Velocidade é conversão. O objetivo é consulta PAGA. Vamos deixar claro: agendar não é o objetivo. Faturar é. Consulta marcada que não acontece é zero no caixa. Consulta marcada que não paga é prejuízo de tempo. O ciclo só fecha quando a consulta é paga e realizada. Base de pacientes é ouro. Sabe aquela planilha de pacientes antigos que ninguém mexe? Isso é dinheiro parado. Cada nome ali é uma mulher que já confiou na clínica, já viu resultado, já tem relacionamento. Reativar a base é mais fácil que conquistar lead novo. E você vai fazer isso todo dia. Follow-up é onde o dinheiro está. A maioria das secretárias manda preço e espera. Você não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu depois do orçamento só precisa do lembrete certo no momento certo. Seu follow-up é o que separa agenda vazia de agenda lotada. NÃO É PRA VOCÊ SE: ● Acha follow-up \"chato\" ou \"insistente demais\" ● Manda preço e espera a cliente decidir sozinha ● Tem vergonha de puxar a conversa pra venda ● Acha que responder \"quando der\" é aceitável ● Desaparece no horário de almoço quando os leads estão pipocando ● Vê atendimento como tarefa, não como oportunidade de fechar ● Precisa que alguém fique cobrando pra você fazer follow-up É PRA VOCÊ SE: ● Entende que cada lead ignorado é dinheiro perdido ● Sente satisfação real quando converte uma conversa difícil ● Faz follow-up naturalmente - não precisa de lembrete ● Age como se cada lead fosse dinheiro do seu bolso ● Tem organização: não deixa nada cair no esquecimento ● Gosta de ritmo intenso e resultado visível ● Entende que vender bem é atender bem A CANDIDATA DOS SONHOS TEM: Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto. Fome de resultado: Você quer converter. Quer bater meta. Quer ver o número subir. Resiliência: \"Vou pensar\" não te desanima. Te dá mais vontade de fazer o follow-up certo. Organização obsessiva: CRM atualizado, follow-ups no dia certo, zero lead esquecido. Sem precisar de cobrança. Ownership: Você trata cada lead como se fosse dinheiro do seu bolso. Porque, com comissão, é. Ritmo: Você aguenta carga intensa. E gosta disso. title: Appointment Setter (m/w/d) | Remote | Deutsch
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Appointment Setter (m/w/d) | Remote | Deutsch em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Stell dir vor, du arbeitest von einem Coworking-Space auf Mallorca. Blauer Himmel, Meer, und du buchst gerade den nächsten Termin für dein Team. Das ist kein Urlaub. Das ist dein Job. Was hinter dieser Stelle steckt  Harucon Ventures skaliert E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Markt mit Google Ads auf ein neues Level. Wir sind kein 08/15-Arbeitgeber, wir bauen ein Team, das remote arbeitet, aber trotzdem zusammen ist.  Und wir haben entschieden, dass \"zusammen\" auch bedeutet: einmal im Jahr gemeinsam an einem der schönsten Orte Europas. Dieses Jahr? Mallorca. Nächstes Jahr? Portugal. Immer anders. Immer unvergesslich. Deine Rolle  Du bist der erste Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden. Über LinkedIn und Social Media baust du echte Gespräche auf, qualifizierst Interessenten und buchst Ersttermine für unser Closing-Team. Kein Cold Calling. Reines Chat-Outreach, mit Skripten und Prozessen, die funktionieren. Du musst nichts erfinden. Du kriegst alles an die Hand, was du brauchst, und wirst von Anfang an eng begleitet. Was du mitbringst  Deutsch auf höchstem Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich (C2 oder vergleichbar), da unser gesamter Markt DACH ist und jede Nachricht perfekt klingen muss Du bist auf LinkedIn und Social Media zuhause und weißt, wie man dort echte Gespräche führt Verlässlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung Sales-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Einstellungskriterium  Was du bekommst  Hier verdienst du solide, von Tag eins. Kein \"lass uns erstmal schauen\", kein Vertrösten. Du kennst dein Fixgehalt, bevor du auch nur eine Nachricht schreibst, und es liegt deutlich über dem Marktdurchschnitt. Dazu kommt ein Bonus für jeden gebuchten Termin. Dein Einsatz bestimmt direkt, was am Monatsende auf dem Konto landet. Und weil wir keine Stunden zählen, sondern Ergebnisse: Wer liefert, hat bei uns maximale Freiheit. Kein Micro-Management, keine Kontrolle, keine Rechtfertigungen. Du bist erwachsen, wir behandeln dich so. Außerdem:  100 % remote, du arbeitest wo und wann du willst Jährliches Team-Coworking auf Mallorca und Portugal, abwechselnd, alle Kosten übernommen Alle Tools, Skripte und Prozesse werden dir gestellt, du startest nicht bei null Schnelles Onboarding, enge Begleitung, kein Micro-Management Ein ambitioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig weiterbringt Klare Entwicklungsperspektive, wer hier gut ist, wächst mit uns  Wie du dich bewirbst  Kein Lebenslauf, keine lange Bewerbung. Schick uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht direkt hier über LinkedIn und erzähl uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wer du bist und warum dich diese Stelle reizt. Wir melden uns schnell.

title: Data Analyst
description:

Position Summary The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI. Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query. Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability. Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting. Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders. Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning. Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions. Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs. Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices. Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities. Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.  Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling. Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently. Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences. Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Passion for data visualization, continuous learning, and process improvement. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills.  Education, Training, and Experience High school diploma required; college degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role required. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI required. Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models required. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and analytics tools preferred. Experience presenting data insights to leadership and non-technical audiences preferred.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Nova vaga disponível para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Company Description:  MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview:  As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details:   Duration of Contract : 6 months Pay:  $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work:  Fully Remote Number of Positions:  20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese )   Skills:  Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).  Key Qualifications:  Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese )  with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese  is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.  Education & Experience:  BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.  Additional Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months
